entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, that trip to Hawaii was a lot lamer[n]than I expected. We didn't even have[n]money to do anything...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, plans were up in the air, and the[n]school was a bit understaffed.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We did have a pretty big surprise once[n]we got there, though...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. You.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was quite a shock how your plans[n]changed so suddenly due to that storm...[n]It's like you bring rain everywhere you go.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I had been experiencing sunny weather[n]for quite some time. It did strike me as[n]unusual...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I suppose the rain built up for a while,[n]causing the dam to burst upon the[n]school trip.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is that how it works!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Haru, do you go overseas often? You[n]seemed so calm during the school trip.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You're probably used to it, huh? I bet[n]you've been on day trips where you fly[n]to Hawaii just to shop and come back.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, no, nothing like that...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's just that I'd rather focus on the[n]people around me than the location[n]we happen to be in.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So you could go anywhere in the world[n]and it would be worthless next to your[n]precious friends... That's so sweet, Haru!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, I didn't say it quite like that.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You all went to Hawaii for your school[n]trip, right? They must have a healthy[n]budget these days.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh? Where did you go on your school[n]trips, Boss?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Did you even have school trips back[n]then? That was like, what, the 1920s?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Come on, I'm not THAT old.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Times were a little simpler, sure, but[n]we had a great time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's crazy to imagine him as kid... Now[n]I'm getting curious.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hawaii, huh... I remember. The guys[n]were nearly peeing their pants before[n]they even left for the airport.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's just a field trip... So immature.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's not like I was jealous or anything!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah! We're not jealous of those stupid[n]happy students and their stupid fun[n]vacations!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Let's all go together next time.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We went to Hawaii for a school trip,[n]but you were there for training camp,[n]weren't you?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Yeah!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But since we were there for practice, we[n]didn't really get to do anything special.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So you were training all day, every day?[n]That sounds pretty tough.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: There's no denying that.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But the really tough part was holding[n]back my hunger!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So much steak... Loco moco...[n]Pancakes...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, I hate that feeling! You want to eat it,[n]but you just can't! How did you manage?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I got over it by closing my eyes and[n]pretending broccoli was a sirloin steak.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I don't know if you can call that "getting[n]over it."
